title: Sora (bird)
blurb: The sora, sora rail or Carolina crake is a small waterbird of the rail family Rallidae, sometimes also referred to as the sora rail or sora crake, that occurs throughout much of North America.
facts: The common name "Sora" is probably derived from a Native American language.
